missions.name: Farm Monitoring Demonstrator
missions.description: Priority mission. Observe a defined farm property, find cattle outside their enclosure and other events needing the owner's attention, and deliver an actionable notification.
missions.narrative: Start of the limited Family of Systems: an outdoor UAV, fixed sensing and a shared operator and notification service. Response decisions stay with people and external services.

missions.narrative: Extension increment H. Reuses the notification service; no automatic inheritance of aircraft suitability.

missions.name: Personal Safety and Assistance

missions.narrative: Extension increment H. Tested first with the non-airborne members of the Family of Systems.

use_cases.name: Monitor enclosure and report escaped cattle
use_cases.description: Monitor enclosure, detect candidate escape, confirm location, notify, obtain acknowledgment and close event.
steps: Operator approves the patrol and the enclosure boundary for the operating envelope
UAV or fixed sensor observes the enclosure boundary
System detects a candidate boundary crossing and estimates its location
System compares the location with the enclosure and confirms or rejects the candidate
Notification service sends the event with time, location, uncertainty and image evidence
Farmer acknowledges; unacknowledged events escalate to the named alternate
On loss of observation or delivery, the system reports unavailable coverage
Farmer closes the event after recovery

use_cases.name: Report animal encounter near livestock
use_cases.description: Observe livestock, report a concerning animal encounter and sound an alarm only when the owner authorizes it.
steps: System observes the livestock area
System reports a candidate encounter with evidence and uncertainty
Owner reviews and may authorize the audible alarm
System records the outcome

use_cases.name: Observe property incident and preserve evidence
use_cases.description: Covers S02, S03 and J02: observe a person, vehicle or fire on the property, preserve evidence and notify.
steps: System observes the defined area
System reports the observation without classifying intent
Evidence is stored with access control
Owner decides whether to contact an external response service

use_cases.name: Survey crop and orchard condition
use_cases.description: Covers T02 and T03: collect imagery over fields or orchard blocks and flag areas for inspection.
steps: Operator selects the survey area
UAV collects imagery
System flags candidate areas
Farmer inspects and records ground truth

use_cases.name: Record arrivals, departures and intrusions
use_cases.description: Covers D01 to D03 and J01 with fixed and personal sensing; UAV coverage is optional.
steps: Fixed or personal sensor detects an event
System records video and audio under the agreed consent rules
System notifies the family silently when configured
Family member decides on external response

use_cases.name: Request assistance and record an encounter
use_cases.description: Covers K01, K02 and B01 to B03: a person requests or confirms help; the system shares location and context.
steps: Person requests help or the device detects a possible fall
System asks the person to confirm when possible
System notifies the caregiver or campus service with location and context
Recipient acknowledges; unacknowledged requests escalate

mission_requirements.title: Actionable awareness of escaped cattle
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall give the farmer timely, actionable awareness of cattle outside the defined enclosure within the approved operating envelope. Effectiveness measure MOE-T01; threshold TBD (G2).

mission_requirements.title: Alert on animal encounter near livestock
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall alert the owner to a concerning animal encounter near livestock and shall sound an audible alarm only on the owner's authorization.

mission_requirements.title: Observe property incidents and preserve evidence
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall observe incidents on the defined property, preserve evidence and notify the owner, leaving assessment and external response to people.

mission_requirements.title: Flag crop and orchard areas for inspection
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall identify crop and orchard areas for inspection, validated against ground truth by crop and season.

mission_requirements.title: Home and family awareness with evidence
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall provide awareness and an access-controlled record of encounters and alarms at the home and car using fixed and personal sensing first.

mission_requirements.title: Assistance request with location and context
mission_requirements.text: The Family of Systems shall deliver a user-initiated or confirmed assistance request with location and context to a named recipient, without medical diagnosis.

system_requirements.title: Report confirmed boundary crossing
system_requirements.text: Within the approved operating envelope, the system shall report a confirmed enclosure boundary crossing within latency L after the ground-truth crossing time. L is TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Crossing report content
system_requirements.text: Each crossing report shall contain event time, location with uncertainty, image evidence and delivery state. Acceptance criteria are TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Indicate unavailable coverage
system_requirements.text: On loss of observation or delivery capability, the system shall indicate unavailable coverage and follow the approved degraded mode.

system_requirements.title: Patrol coverage of the enclosure
system_requirements.text: The UAV shall observe the defined enclosure boundary with a revisit interval of R. R is TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Patrol energy with reserve
system_requirements.text: The UAV shall complete the approved patrol and return with a usable-energy reserve of E_res. E_res is TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Geolocate an observation
system_requirements.text: The UAV shall estimate the ground location of an observation and report its uncertainty. The error limit is TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Link status and loss-of-link behavior
system_requirements.text: The UAV shall report command and telemetry link status and, on loss of link, shall follow the approved failsafe.

system_requirements.title: Time-stamped image evidence
system_requirements.text: The payload shall capture image evidence time-stamped against the common time source.

system_requirements.title: Authorized audible alarm only
system_requirements.text: The UAV shall sound its audible alarm only while an operator authorization is active.

system_requirements.title: Delivery state, acknowledgment and escalation
system_requirements.text: The notification service shall record delivery state and recipient acknowledgment for each event and shall escalate an unacknowledged event to the named alternate after T_ack. T_ack is TBD (G2).

system_requirements.title: Evidence retention and access control
system_requirements.text: The evidence store shall keep recordings under the access and retention rules approved for the deployment.

system_requirements.title: Fixed and wearable events without an aircraft
system_requirements.text: Fixed and wearable devices shall send their events to the notification service without an aircraft being airborne.

system_requirements.title: Report observations, not judgments
system_requirements.text: The system shall report observations with their uncertainty and shall not label a person as a criminal.

system_requirements.title: Common time source
system_requirements.text: All event, evidence and delivery timestamps shall be traceable to one common time source.

measures.name: Actionable escape awareness
measures.definition: Fraction of staged escapes that lead to a timely, actionable farmer acknowledgment.
measures.denominator: Staged escapes inside the approved operating envelope

measures.name: Detection probability
measures.definition: Staged crossings detected / staged crossings observed under stated conditions.

measures.name: False alerts per monitored hour
measures.definition: Alerts with no ground-truth crossing / monitored hours.

measures.name: Localization error
measures.definition: Horizontal distance between reported and surveyed crossing location.

measures.name: Notification latency
measures.definition: Recipient delivery time minus ground-truth crossing time.

measures.name: Mission availability
measures.definition: Time with coverage available / scheduled monitoring time.

verification.procedure: Staged crossings and non-crossing controls with independent, time-stamped ground truth; compare event and delivery logs.
Inspect each delivered report for the required fields.
Remove observation, then delivery; confirm the unavailable-coverage indication and degraded mode.
Run uav_t01_mission; compute the revisit interval from the patrol.
Run the energy analysis with the reviewed mission segments; independent check of units and reserve.

ledger.objective: Inventory PD Quick, MATLAB R2011a and R2025b, UModel, Fusion and Unreal; record versions and licenses.
Round trip: one PD Quick record, one native diagram and one deterministic analysis saved and read back.
Seed the source register: 6 stakeholders, 16 needs, 5 excluded scenes, open questions.
Review each need with its stakeholder; resolve the open questions; record G1 disposition.
Derive mission and system requirements; allocate to systems and WBS; export catalogs.
Create UModel requirement, block definition and use case diagrams with deriveReqt, satisfy and verify.
Build the R2011a WBS model; link blocks to PD Quick, Excel and Word requirements with the V&V toolbox.
Run the DATCOM fixed-wing candidate; record applicability limits.
Create the multirotor candidate parts, assembly and drawing in Fusion; record mass properties.
Build and check the Simscape propulsion and power model in R2025b.
Pull the R2011a subsystems into an R2025b model; compare both releases back to back.
Run the T01 scenario with the Unreal scene in the loop.
Approve release to fabrication, powered tests and flight.
